sources.title: If you can't set up an eSIM on your iPhone - Apple Support
sources.excerpt: ﻿ If you can't set up an eSIM on your iPhone - Apple Support If you can't set up an eSIM on your iPhone Learn what to do if you can't set up an eSIM on your iPhone. Learn more about eSIM What you need Your new iPhone must be connected to a Wi-Fi network or hotspot. In some countries and regions, iPhone models that are eSIM-only can activate without a Wi-Fi network. An active cellular plan and eSIM on your iPhone from a carrier that supports eSIM Your iPhone or iPhone devices need the latest version of iOS that they can use . Follow these steps After following each step below, open Control Center by swiping down from the upper-right corner of the screen. Check if your carrier appears in the status bar. If not, go to the next step. Turn Airplane Mode on and off . Open the Settings app and tap Cellular. Check if the number you're trying to activate is shown. If it is, turn off the line and then turn it back on again. Restart your device. On iPhone models running iOS 18 or later, you can download the latest version of the Apple Support app to run additional diagnostics that might help determine the source of your device's issue. Check the carrier settings Check the carrier settings on your device. Open the Settings app. Tap General Tap About. Scroll down to the eSIM section. Your iPhone's carrier name and a version number is next to Carrier. Tap the version number. If an update is available, you'll see a prompt to select OK or Update. Contact your carrier If you still can't set up an eSIM on your iPhone, contact your carrier . Gathering the following information ahead of time might be helpful: Note the error message you are seeing on your iPhone. Collect your iPhone and carrier account identifiers: Your phone number Your carrier account password and/or PIN Your iPhone's IMEI or EID. To find them open the Settings app. Tap General and then tap About. Published Date: April 23, 2026 Helpful? Yes No Character limit: 250 Maximum character limit is 250. claims.claim: 아이폰이 와이파이나 핫스팟에 연결되어 있어야 eSIM을 활성화할 수 있다.
claims.quote: Your new iPhone must be connected to a Wi-Fi network or hotspot.

claims.claim: eSIM을 지원하는 통신사의 활성화된 셀룰러 요금제가 있어야 한다.
claims.quote: An active cellular plan and eSIM on your iPhone from a carrier that supports eSIM

claims.claim: 아이폰은 사용 가능한 최신 iOS 버전을 사용해야 한다.
claims.quote: Your iPhone or iPhone devices need the latest version of iOS that they can use.

claims.claim: 설정 > 일반 > 정보에서 통신사 설정 업데이트를 확인하고 필요하면 진행해야 한다.
claims.quote: Open the Settings app. Tap General Tap About. Scroll down to the eSIM section. Tap the version number. If an update is available, you'll see a prompt to select OK or Update.

claims.claim: 설정 후 상태 바에 통신사 이름이 나타나지 않으면 비행기 모드를 켰다 꺼보고 셀룰러 라인을 재설정하거나 기기를 재시작해야 한다.
claims.quote: Check if your carrier appears in the status bar. If not, ... Turn Airplane Mode on and off. Open the Settings app and tap Cellular... Restart your device.

claims.claim: 문제가 지속되면 통신사에 연락하여 오류 메시지, 전화번호, 계정 정보, IMEI 또는 EID를 제공하는 것이 도움이 된다.
claims.quote: If you still can't set up an eSIM on your iPhone, contact your carrier. Gathering the following information ahead of time might be helpful: ... Your phone number ... IMEI or EID.

limitations: 인용문 일치는 사실의 정확성·최신성·주장 전체의 근거를 보장하지 않습니다.
모델이 중요한 주장을 누락했을 수 있어 제목·요약·본문 전체를 검토해야 합니다.
입국·비자·정책은 관할 정부 기관의 직접 발표를 별도로 확인해야 합니다.
